chrome · Windose × Jirai — window chrome R3.
   Scope: only the two real chrome bars. No invented text, icons, DOM or events.
   Every selector is anchored to a real attribute or a literal class token of the
   app source (main app is read-only; paths relative to /home/fulutang/Documents/Github/VRCX-0-jirai):
     - src/components/layout/AppTitleBar.tsx:90-96   <header data-app-titlebar="true" class="vrcx-0-titlebar … h-8 …">
     - src/components/layout/AppTitleBar.tsx:43      window buttons: "h-full w-9 rounded-none border-0"
     - src/components/layout/AppTitleBar.tsx:83,148,157,170  MinusIcon / Square|CopyIcon / XIcon stay as-is
     - src/components/layout/AppTitleBar.tsx:165     close keeps "hover:bg-destructive! hover:text-destructive-foreground!"
     - src/components/layout/status-bar/StatusBarFooter.tsx:353,371  <footer data-vrcx-0-surface="statusbar" class="vrcx-0-statusbar …">
   These rules are unlayered, so they outrank Tailwind's @layer utilities; the two
   "!" utilities on the close button are NOT overridden on purpose (see R3-3b).
   Line numbers are the 2026-10-11 20:38 UTC snapshot; runtime/windose-runtime.css
   is being edited concurrently by the Lead (the fake pink page header it used to
   draw is already gone), so match by selector, not by line, when re-checking.
   R4 adds the quick-search control, key caps, brand plate, help trigger and the
   status pixel square; the R4 block at the end carries its source evidence.
